clue.text: Clergyman receiving company of clergyman

indicators.note: the first clergyman takes in, or receives, the company abbreviation inside him

parts.note: a dean is a senior clergyman in charge of a cathedral

explanation.surface: One churchman takes in a group of other churchmen.
explanation.definitionFit: A deacon is an ordained minister ranking below a priest, so a type of clergyman.

clue.text: Talk about sporting event on Saturday

parts.note: the discus is an athletics throwing event
S abbreviates Saturday

explanation.surface: People chat about the weekend athletics meet.
explanation.definitionFit: To discuss is to talk a subject over.

clue.text: Anything revealed by daughter

indicators.note: the answer is revealed within the letters of the next word

explanation.surface: Anything at all is exposed by a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Aught is an old word meaning anything at all.

clue.text: A large number in dance with officer in charge for company

indicators.note: with links the replacement piece that comes into the dance
one piece stands for, replacing, another

parts.note: a cotillion is an old formal dance
OC is officer commanding, the officer in charge

explanation.surface: A big crowd at the dance with the commanding officer.
explanation.walkthrough: In COTILLION the CO is swapped for OC.
explanation.definitionFit: An octillion is a huge number, ten to the 27th power in the short scale.

clue.text: Psychedelic capsule is pricy

indicators.note: psychedelic suggests something distorted and swirling, so the letters of the next word are jumbled

explanation.surface: A capsule of hallucinogen costs a lot of money.
explanation.definitionFit: Upscale goods are aimed at the wealthier end of the market, hence expensive.

clue.text: Ruin a French execution

parts.note: un is French for a
doing is the performance or execution of something

explanation.surface: A French beheading brings destruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's undoing is their downfall, the cause of their ruin.

clue.text: Having no money, family is thrown in street

indicators.note: the family word is thrown inside the street abbreviation

parts.note: kin means family

explanation.surface: A poor family is cast out on the street.
explanation.definitionFit: Skint is British slang for broke, penniless.

clue.text: French composer's universal god of the ear

parts.note: Georges Auric was a French composer, one of Les Six
U is the British film rating for universal
a Lar is a Roman household god

explanation.surface: A French musician's all-purpose deity of hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Auricular means relating to the ear or to hearing.

clue.text: Measure silence and put in note to incriminate

indicators.note: the note is put in between the two other pieces

parts.note: an en is a printer's measure
sh is a call for silence
me (or mi) is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Measure and quiet a note to frame someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put in' places the note between the measure and the silence; EN is a printer's unit half an em wide.
explanation.definitionFit: To enmesh is to entangle, so to involve someone in guilt.

clue.text: Red newt found in resting place

indicators.note: the newt word is found inside the resting place word

parts.note: the lie of a ball is where it comes to rest
an eft is a newt

explanation.surface: A red newt turns up where something lies.
explanation.definitionFit: A Red is a communist or socialist, a left-winger.

clue.text: Play unprepared lament and march

parts.note: to sigh is to lament or grieve
to tread is to walk or march

explanation.surface: Someone moans and parades around.
explanation.definitionFit: To sight-read music is to perform it at first sight without rehearsal.

clue.text: King wearing one bad actor's pilgrimage robe

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the king abbreviation is worn by, so placed inside, the word for a bad actor

parts.note: a ham is a bad, overacting actor
R, for Rex, abbreviates king

explanation.surface: A monarch dresses in an incompetent performer's clothing.
explanation.walkthrough: R (king) goes inside HAM to give HRAM, after I.
explanation.definitionFit: The ihram is the white garment worn by Muslims on the hajj pilgrimage to Mecca.

clue.text: Endlessly free student up to the time when …

indicators.note: without its end means the final letter of the synonym for free is dropped

parts.note: to untie is to free or loosen
L is the learner plate, a student driver

explanation.surface: A learner is set loose without limit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endlessly' removes the E from UNTIE, leaving UNTI.
explanation.definitionFit: The conjunction until means up to the point in time when something happens.

clue.text: … his strict revision of poems …

indicators.note: revising the words reworks their letters into a new order

explanation.surface: He revises his own rigid verses.
explanation.definitionFit: A tristich is a poem or stanza of three lines, so these are poems.

clue.text: … of Muslim mystic, embracing fine church, meet requirements

indicators.note: the mystic holds the fine abbreviation in an embrace, enclosing it

parts.note: a Sufi is a Muslim mystic
F is the pencil grading abbreviation for fine
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A mystic hugs a fine church and satisfies needs.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipses only carry the reading on from the previous clues; 'of' is a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: To suffice is to be enough, so to satisfy what is needed.

clue.text: Story has fooled doctor

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tale has duped the physician.
explanation.definitionFit: A story, in the informal sense, is a lie.

clue.text: Pest nowadays interrupts great career

indicators.note: the nowadays piece breaks into the middle of the other two, interrupting them

parts.note: G is an abbreviation for great, as in G for grand
to career is to rush along, to fly
AD, anno Domini, marks the present era

explanation.surface: A modern nuisance breaks into a fine profession.
explanation.definitionFit: A gadfly is a biting fly and figuratively an annoying, provocative person.

clue.text: Created a rumpus about second scholar being emasculated

indicators.note: the din word goes about, around, the other pieces

parts.note: to din is to make a loud noise, so dinned
MA, Master of Arts, is a scholar

explanation.surface: Someone kicked up a fuss over a castrated scholar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Being' is a link: the definition is the bare past participle, matching the verb form built by the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To unman someone, to deprive them of manhood, is to emasculate them.

clue.text: Twins getting about not accompanied by Bob

parts.note: C, circa, means about
lone means alone, not accompanied
a bob was a shilling in old British money, abbreviated S

explanation.surface: A pair of twins gets by without Robert.
explanation.walkthrough: A bob is the old British shilling, abbreviated S from the Latin solidus.
explanation.definitionFit: Clones are genetically identical copies, so like identical twins.

clue.text: Good time's over — slip away having a cold

indicators.note: over in a down clue means the fun word is turned back

parts.note: fun is a good time; with the 's it gives FUNS
to fly is to flee or slip away

explanation.surface: The party's over, so someone sneaks off feeling ill.
explanation.definitionFit: Being snuffly means sniffing a lot, as with a cold.

clue.text: Holds sailor's globes

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor; with the 's it gives ABS
orbs are globes or spheres

explanation.surface: A seaman owns some spheres.
explanation.definitionFit: To absorb is to take in and hold, as a sponge holds water.

clue.text: A dilapidated lodge is ancient

indicators.note: a dilapidated building is falling apart, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tumbledown lodge is very old.
explanation.definitionFit: Age-old means existing for a very long time, so ancient.

clue.text: Missile Sian revealed in Europe

indicators.note: the answer is revealed among the letters of the words before it

explanation.surface: Sian has a missile shown in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Silesia is a historical region lying in central Europe, now mostly in Poland.

clue.text: Pass up a drink in this area

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the pass word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
ale is a drink

explanation.surface: Raise a drink to people around here.
explanation.definitionFit: A locale is a particular place or area.

clue.text: Frank's business providing hospitality for all

parts.note: frank means open or candid; the 's is read as 'is'
a house is a business firm, as in a publishing house

explanation.surface: Frank's company welcomes everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping open house means welcoming any visitor freely, so general hospitality.

clue.text: One under cover fell upon rebel leader

indicators.note: in a down clue upon means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: a fell is an animal skin, a hide

indicators.note: the leader of the word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A rebel chief falls on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A hider is someone who conceals themselves, someone under cover.

clue.text: Bone found in Mexican village

indicators.note: the answer is found inside the letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A skeleton bone turns up in a Mexican village.
explanation.definitionFit: The anvil, or incus, is one of the small bones of the middle ear.

clue.text: Books about Italy got together for old consorts

indicators.note: the books word goes about, around, the Italy letter

parts.note: vols abbreviates volumes
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: Books on Italy gathered for old partners.
explanation.definitionFit: Viols were early stringed instruments played in ensembles called consorts.

clue.text: Steer clear of love in passionate surroundings

indicators.note: the love letter sits in the next piece, placed inside it
the passionate word forms the surroundings that enclose the love letter

parts.note: avid means eager or passionate
O is love, a nil score in tennis

explanation.surface: Keep away from love in a heated setting.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid something is to keep away from it.

clue.text: Foul noise disturbed criminal

indicators.note: disturbed letters are thrown out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: An offensive racket upset someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Felonious means relating to a felony, a serious crime, so criminal.

clue.text: Old tree lay hollowed out

parts.note: the elder is a small tree

indicators.note: with its inside removed the word keeps only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: An old tree lay with its trunk hollow.
explanation.definitionFit: Elderly describes someone getting on in years, so old.

clue.text: Lay with fool returning from Black Sea port

parts.note: a lay is a song or poem, an ode

indicators.note: returning means the fool word is read backwards

parts.note: an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A song and a fool come back from the coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Odessa is the major Ukrainian port on the Black Sea.
